esp32.detail: 6 pins wired; RDM6300 125 kHz RFID reader needs at least 4.75 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.TX → RX2 (the board's RX), RX → TX2 (the board's TX). Added a 10 kΩ / 20 kΩ divider on TX: it swings to 5 V, and the RX2 pin takes 3.3 V at most. Added the rdm6300.py driver written from the datasheet.
Prints the ID of the tag held near the coil: passes

pico.detail: 6 pins wired; RDM6300 125 kHz RFID reader needs at least 4.75 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.TX → GP1 (the board's RX), RX → GP0 (the board's TX). Added a 10 kΩ / 20 kΩ divider on TX: it swings to 5 V, and the GP1 pin takes 3.3 V at most. Added the rdm6300.py driver written from the datasheet.
Prints the ID of the tag held near the coil: passes
